settings.label: About
settings.heading: 99WRLDWIDE
settings.text:
99WRLDWIDE is the clothing brand under 99. Black and white, built on 1990s football and today's streetwear.

Every piece is made to order and printed in the EU, so we don't hold stock and nothing sits in a warehouse.
